identity.fantasy: An aggressive scythe executioner who builds fragments through Doomrend and Reap, sustains through violence, and accelerates into Blood Frenzy and execute range.
identity.one_line: An aggressive scythe executioner who builds fragments through Doomrend and Reap, sustains through violence, and accelerates into Blood Frenzy and execute range. The defining decision is contextual: Target health, sustain needs, and available souls change Reap, Murder, or Slaughter choices.

mechanics.core_loop: An aggressive scythe executioner using Doomrend, Slaughter, Reap, Murder, bleeds, and Harvesting Grounds. It builds fragments, sustains through damage, and accelerates into Blood Frenzy and execute windows. Its kit is especially attractive in PvP because it combines chase, pressure, and self-healing.

modes.structural_description: Using Reap now transforms your Reap into Thresh for 10 sec.ThreshGenerates 1 Soul Fragment Strike enemies around you, dealing 110% Weapon Damage and generating Runic Power.Upon cast, this ability transforms into Bloodshatter for 10 sec.BloodshatterGenerates 1 Soul Fragment Strike enemies in front of you, dealing 329 + 20% AP Shadow damage and generating Runic Power.Your next Reliquary of the Lost within 10 seconds now triggers a -25% reduced cooldown.

modes.name: Shudder Scythe
modes.structural_description: Your Murder is transformed into Shudder Scythe, which costs additional Runic Power but deals increased damage and generates Soul Fragments.Shudder Scythe (Transform)Strike an enemy 5 times, each dealing 30% Weapon Damage, scaling with level, and granting you a Soul Fragment with each strike.

mechanics.single_target: A captured PvP opener uses Ruin plus Shudder Scythe for immediate fragments, souls, and sustain before Reap, Murder, Doomrend, and sub-35-percent Slaughter. A separate level-45 PvE report starts Reap, Deathwind, Crow Harvest, Reliquary, and Soulslam; neither is universal.
mechanics.aoe: Harvesting and soul generation improve in sustained contact. A level-45 player describes an AoE sequence, while broader reports conflict on whether Harvest is exceptional or weak before later Reliquary changes.
mechanics.movement_and_target_switching: Chase tools support PvP contact and large-pull aggression.
mechanics.defense_and_control: Its structural defensive package includes Doomrend, Harvester, Slaughter, Extinction, Callous Soul.
mechanics.group_utility: Group or control tools include Blood Harvester, The Time Has Come, Sever, Unbound, The Grim Reaper.

failure_modes.text: Opening without fragments and souls, losing contact during Blood Frenzy, or firing Slaughter outside execute range reduces damage and self-healing together.
Using Slaughter before the target enters execute range spends a defining payoff without its intended condition.
A PvP opener copied directly into PvE can misallocate souls because the documented contexts use different sequences.
